claims.text: FT(PMC) (First‑Timer – Previously Married Couple) is a BTO category for couples where at least one spouse previously owned an HDB flat but sold it before 1 January 2019 and the couple now meets all other first‑timer criteria.
If the previous flat was sold after 1 January 2019, the couple is generally not eligible for FT(PMC) and must apply under the regular First‑Timer (FT) category.
Check the HFE (Housing Flat Eligibility) letter or HDB portal to confirm the exact sale date of Darren's previous flat and whether it meets the pre‑2019 requirement for FT(PMC).
Gather supporting documents such as the sale deed of the previous flat, HFE letter, NRICs, and marriage certificate to be ready for the BTO application.
Eligibility rules can change; verify the latest FT(PMC) criteria on the HDB website (hdb.gov.sg) or the HDB Flat Portal before applying.
